name: Sticky 2048
summary: A native ESP-IDF 2048 game demo running on reTerminal Sticky with E-Ink display and touch control.
description: A community 2048 game demo for reTerminal Sticky. The project uses native ESP-IDF development with a 1-bit E-Ink framebuffer, GT911 touch input, partial refresh optimization, battery status display, and hardware integration.

compatibility.notes: Tested on Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky with ESP32-S3 and E-Ink display.

steps.title: Download the project
steps.description: Download and extract the ESP-IDF project archive.

steps.title: Build the firmware
steps.description: Open the project with ESP-IDF v5.4 and build the firmware.

steps.title: Flash the device
steps.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky through USB and flash the firmware.
